name: pistol squat to box
description: A single-leg squat down to a box. The box gives you a target for depth as you build strength.
instructions: Stand in front of a box with one leg extended forward.
Brace your core and reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit back and down slowly on the standing leg until you touch the box.
Drive through your heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
